label: D1 after an a1 choice that led (rarely) to S2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2) and only in the second half of the episode (zero activations before ep_trial 50; rate rises steadily from trial 50 to 99, so there is a slow within-episode drift). Within that, it fires when the previous trial was a1 followed by a rare transition to S2 (prev_action==1 & prev_common==0 carries 83% of mass; previous a2 or common transitions almost never fire). The previous reward is mostly 0 (80% of mass) but rewarded rare trials fire too, so requiring prev_reward==0 lowers F1. Active steps have low-to-mid model value (<7.2) and a moderate a1-leaning upcoming policy logit, and fall mostly in S1-good blocks. Misses are mainly window-first trials where the previous trial is outside the window, and some cases after other trial types. False positives are the same a1-rare-to-S2 D1 events where it stays silent; stricter ep_trial (>=70) or value cutoffs trade recall for precision without a clean boundary. Magnitude was not cleanly tied to a single variable. All variables used are observed at D1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 8 (9 = most a1) (+4.28), phase=D1 & last=a1 S2 r (+4.12), phase=D1 & last=a2 S2 r (+3.72), phase=D1 & before=a1 S2 u (+3.71), phase=D1 & ep_dec=9 (+3.10), phase=D1 & ep_dec=8 (+2.59).
